# Testing Rules


When creating testing documents:


Always:

1.
Read requirements from:

/eshop-sut/README.md

or

/eshop-sut/Requirements



2.
Use:

Domain Testing

Boundary Value Analysis



3.
Use:

/docs/test-case-template.md



4.
Include:

- Requirement Analysis
- Testing Technique
- Test Cases
- Human Review



5.
Record AI usage into:

/docs/ai-audit-report.md
